$comment: Citation ledger: which real file/line backs each N0-layer decision. Degrades gracefully (warns, does not fail) in extraction/verify_all.mjs when no sibling source tree (the project root outside design-repo/) is present — e.g. when this folder is copied or zipped standalone. Paths here are relative to the PROJECT ROOT (one level above design-repo/), not to design-repo/ itself, since they cite build-time evidence outside the shipped package — this file is the correct home for that, per MASTER-GUIDE 3.9, not registry.manifest.json's entryPoints.

citations.claim: React Router route table matches README's Routes section
Blog post bodies are intentional empty stubs
BlogPost.jsx renders a literal placeholder when body is empty
Contact form posts nowhere, sets local state only
Product detail renders exactly 3 features per product
Related posts is always exactly 2, via .slice(0,2)
Home-updates uses an explicit FEATURED_SLUGS editorial list, not a slice
CTA is rendered by Footer as its first child, not by any page
Reveal motion is an IntersectionObserver equivalent, not measured Framer CSS
Marquee track duplicate-and-loop technique, 40s linear infinite
Images/video referenced live from framerusercontent.com, not mirrored
Fonts are substituted (General Sans / Source Serif 4) for licensed originals

citationNote: Every range below is checked against the real file's actual line count by extraction/verify_all.mjs and must not exceed it. A handful of token/CSS claims (marked by an explicit '1-N' full-file range rather than a narrow one) cite the whole file because the relevant values are scattered across it (colors and utility classes are not concentrated in one block) — verify_all.mjs still hard-fails if even a whole-file range exceeds the file's real length, since that would mean the file shrank since this citation was written.
